AC16

**Richardson Co. Nebraska**

Laying on top of moist woodland duff in wet seep, at the base of Northeast-facing mixed oak/hickory woodland slope, near river.
Nearby Trees: Ironwood, Ash, Cottonwood, Chinkapin Oak, Eastern Redbud, Elm, and Sycamore.

Smell: mildly musty to not distinct.

Microscopy: mounted in Melzer's reagent.
